    Bayesian Hyperparameter optimization for PCA via `scramble` algorithm

    bayesian_optimization_PCA_SVD.Rd

    Get optimal penalties using bayesian optimization. Score function depends on whether sparsity is assumed or not

    bayesian_optimization_PCA_SVD(
  X,
  groups,
  rsvd,
  n,
  p,
  k,
  alpha_x,
  loss_type,
  h,
  tol,
  lr,
  epochs,
  lr_decay,
  bounds_input,
  criterion = "TPO"
)

    Arguments

    rsvd

    object resulting from SVD on R

    n

    number of observations

    p

    number of variables in data_x

    alpha_x

    scalar: A positive real scalar between 0 and 1, indicating the elastic net parameter for data_x.

    tol

    tolerance for training algorithm

    lr

    learning rate for gradient descent training algorithm

    epochs

    maximum number of epochs for gradient descent training algorithm

    lr_decay

    parameter for

    criterion

    type of criterion used to determine optimal hyperparameters, default: criterion = TPO

    Q

    Q from QR decomposition on data_x

    R

    R from QR decomposition on data_x

    Value

    a list object containing the optimal hyperparameters and a summary of the optimization process
